snippet.title: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess | 1st Anniversary Trailer
snippet.description:
Capcom's unique, highly rated Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess has won the hearts of players and reviewers alike since its original release in 2024, and saw the addition of a new Otherworldly Ventures mode as well as a Nintendo Switch 2 edition on June 5, 2025.

To celebrate the game's one-year anniversary and as a thank-you to everyone who played the game, we're giving all players the Yashichi Waves Mazo tailsman! When equipped, this item will change the music in certain situations into brand-new 8-bit versions!

Look forward to this fun gift in a free update for all platforms in July!
